  3461: void BubbleSort(EFFECT_ZDEPTH *list, int num)
  3462: {
  3463: 	EFFECT_ZDEPTH temp;
  3464: 	int i, j;
  3465: 
  3466: 	for(i = num; i > 0; i--)
  3467: 	{
  3468: 		for(j = 0; j < i; j++)
  3469: 		{
  3470: 			if(list[j].ZDepth < list[j + 1].ZDepth)
  3471: 			{
  3472: 				temp = list[j + 1];
  3473: 				list[j + 1] = list[j];
  3474: 				list[j] = temp;
  3475: 			}
  3476: 		}
  3477: 	}
  3478: }

   147: smPAT3D *HoEffectResManager::GetResMesh(const std::string &meshName, const std::string &boneName)
   148: {
   149:     if(m_ResMeshMap.find(meshName) == m_ResMeshMap.end())
   150:     {
   151:         HoEffectResMesh *resMesh = new HoEffectResMesh;
   152:         if(boneName.size() == 0)
   153:             resMesh->LoadingRes(meshName);
   154:         else
   155:             resMesh->LoadingRes(meshName, boneName);
   156:         m_ResMeshMap[meshName]	= resMesh;
   157:         return resMesh->GetRes();
   158:     }
   159:     else
   160:         return m_ResMeshMap[meshName]->GetRes();
   161: 
   162:     return NULL;
   163: }

   602: 		ey[0] = (mx * sin + my * cos) >> FLOATNS;

   606: 		ey[1] = (mx * sin + my * cos) >> FLOATNS;

   610: 		ey[2] = (mx * sin + my * cos) >> FLOATNS;
   611:

   613: 		ex[3] = (mx * cos - my * sin) >> FLOATNS;
   614: 		ey[3] = (mx * sin + my * cos) >> FLOATNS;

   616: 
   617: 
   618: 		v[0] = smRender.AddRendVertex(x + ex[0], y + ey[0], z, sColor);
   619: 		v[1] = smRender.AddRendVertex(x + ex[1], y + ey[1], z, sColor);

  1145: #define SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT	(5+FLOATNS) 
  1146: int sinGetMoveLocation2(cSINEFFECT2 *pEffect)
  1147: {
  1148: 	int i, j, k;
  1149: 	int dx, dy, dz;
  1150: 
  1151: 	int sinX, sinY, sinZ;
  1152: 	int cosX, cosY, cosZ;
  1153: 
  1154: 	pEffect->Angle.x &= ANGCLIP;
  1155: 	pEffect->Angle.y &= ANGCLIP;
  1156: 	pEffect->Angle.z &= ANGCLIP;
  1157: 
  1158: 	sinX = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.x] >> 2;
  1159: 	sinY = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.y] >> 2;
  1160: 	sinZ = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.z] >> 2;
  1161: 	cosX = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.x] >> 2;
  1162: 	cosY = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.y] >> 2;
  1163: 	cosZ = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.z] >> 2;
  1164: 
  1165: 
  1166: 	i = (pEffect->MoveSpeed.x * cosZ - pEffect->MoveSpeed.y * sinZ) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1167: 	j = (pEffect->MoveSpeed.x * sinZ + pEffect->MoveSpeed.y * cosZ) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1168: 	k = pEffect->MoveSpeed.z;
  1169: 
  1170: 
  1171: 	dy = (j * cosX - k * sinX) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1172: 	dz = (j * sinX + k * cosX) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1173: 	k = dz;
  1174: 
  1175: 
  1176: 	dx = (k * sinY + i * cosY) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1177: 	dz = (k * cosY - i * sinY) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1178: 
  1179: 	pEffect->Posi.x += dx;
  1180: 	pEffect->Posi.y += dy;
  1181: 	pEffect->Posi.z += dz;
  1182: 
  1183: 	return TRUE;
  1184: }

  3461: void BubbleSort(EFFECT_ZDEPTH *list, int num)
  3462: {
  3463: 	EFFECT_ZDEPTH temp;
  3464: 	int i, j;
  3465: 
  3466: 	for(i = num; i > 0; i--)
  3467: 	{

  3469: 		{
  3470: 			if(list[j].ZDepth < list[j + 1].ZDepth)
  3471: 			{
  3472: 				temp = list[j + 1];
  3473: 				list[j + 1] = list[j];
  3474: 				list[j] = temp;
  3475: 			}
  3476: 		}
  3477: 	}

  1145: #define SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT	(5+FLOATNS) 
  1146: int sinGetMoveLocation2(cSINEFFECT2 *pEffect)
  1147: {
  1148: 	int i, j, k;
  1149: 	int dx, dy, dz;
  1150: 
  1151: 	int sinX, sinY, sinZ;
  1152: 	int cosX, cosY, cosZ;
  1153: 
  1154: 	pEffect->Angle.x &= ANGCLIP;
  1155: 	pEffect->Angle.y &= ANGCLIP;
  1156: 	pEffect->Angle.z &= ANGCLIP;
  1157: 
  1158: 	sinX = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.x] >> 2;
  1159: 	sinY = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.y] >> 2;
  1160: 	sinZ = sdGetSin[pEffect->Angle.z] >> 2;
  1161: 	cosX = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.x] >> 2;
  1162: 	cosY = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.y] >> 2;
  1163: 	cosZ = sdGetCos[pEffect->Angle.z] >> 2;
  1164: 
  1165: 
  1166: 	i = (pEffect->MoveSpeed.x * cosZ - pEffect->MoveSpeed.y * sinZ) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1167: 	j = (pEffect->MoveSpeed.x * sinZ + pEffect->MoveSpeed.y * cosZ) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1168: 	k = pEffect->MoveSpeed.z;
  1169: 
  1170: 
  1171: 	dy = (j * cosX - k * sinX) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1172: 	dz = (j * sinX + k * cosX) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1173: 	k = dz;
  1174: 
  1175: 
  1176: 	dx = (k * sinY + i * cosY) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1177: 	dz = (k * cosY - i * sinY) >> SHHH_ANGF_SFLOAT;
  1178: 
  1179: 	pEffect->Posi.x += dx;
  1180: 	pEffect->Posi.y += dy;
  1181: 	pEffect->Posi.z += dz;
  1182: 
  1183: 	return TRUE;
  1184: }

  1196: 	pEffect->sinFace.z = pEffect->Posi.z;
  1197: 
  1198: 	return TRUE;
  1199: }

   249: 	smRender.SetClipStates(SMCLIP_LEFT | SMCLIP_RIGHT | SMCLIP_TOP | SMCLIP_BOTTOM);
   250: 
   251: 	mobj->Pattern->Frame = Frame;
   252: 	mobj->Pattern->SetPosi(&aposi, &mobj->Angle);
   253: 
   254: 	mobj->Pattern->SetFixPosi();
   255: 	smObjFixPos = TRUE;
   256: 	rcnt = mobj->Pattern->RenderD3D(&Camera, &CameraAngle);
   257: 	smObjFixPos = FALSE;
   258: 
   259: 	mobj->sum = SumCnt;
   260: 	mobj->LastDrawTime = tm2;
   261: 
   262: 	return rcnt;
   263: 
   264: }
   265: 
   266: 
   267: int smSTAGE_OBJECT::Draw(int x, int y, int z, int ax, int ay, int az)
   268: {
   269: 	int h, w;
   270: 	int x1, x2, t;
   271: 	smSTAGE_OBJ3D *mobj;
   272: 
   273: 	Camera.x = x;
   274: 	Camera.y = y;
   275: 	Camera.z = z;
   276: 	CameraAngle.x = ax;
   277: 	CameraAngle.y = ay;
   278: 	CameraAngle.z = az;
   279: 
   280: 	for(h = MapPosiTop; h < MapPosiBot; h++)
   281: 	{
   282: 		x1 = MapPosiLeft[h & 0xFF];
   283: 		x2 = MapPosiRight[h & 0xFF];
   284: 		if(x1 > x2)
   285: 		{
   286: 			t = x1; x1 = x2; x2 = t;
   287: 		}
   288: 
   289: 		for(w = x1; w < x2; w++)
   290: 		{
   291: 			mobj = ObjectMap[w & 0xFF][h & 0xFF];
   292: 			if(mobj)
   293: 			{
   294: 				while(mobj != 0)
   295: 				{
   296: 					if(mobj->sum != SumCnt) Draw(mobj);
   297: 					mobj = mobj->LinkObj;
   298: 				}
   299: 			}
   300: 		}
   301: 	}
   302: 
   303: 	SumCnt++;
   304: 
   305: 	return TRUE;
   306: }
   307:

   312: 	int x1, x2, t;
   313: 	smSTAGE_OBJ3D *mobj;
